newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares end firmer, correction seen.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares end firmer, correction seen.

text.p: Austrian shares edged higher on Tuesday, boosted international strength and gains in oil and chemicals group OMV and traders said the market was in for a correction in the next few days.
"With just one stock this can't last forever and the others were not so bullish," said one trader.
Dealers were also concerned about the possibility of a major Wall Street correction.
"Wall Street is the be all and the end all at present," said one.
Wall Street opened lower on Tuesday after reaching a fresh high on Monday.
Traders said the index was well-supported at 1,200 and saw mild resistance at 1,220 points.
The ATX blue chip index climbed 5.82 points or 0.48 percent to 1,217.47. Among its constituents nine shares rose, 11 fell and one was unchanged.
The top gainer was OMV, rising 3.56 percent to 1,386.40 schillings after publishing strong first-quarter earnings and giving an upbeat assessment for the current year on Monday.
National grid company Verbund dropped three schillings to 855 after posting a 9.5 percent fall in first quarter pretax profit.
The May ATX future shed one point at 1,210.0 on volume of 961 contracts.
